newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW Wed peak, firm power, prices up.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW Wed peak, firm power, prices up.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts (MW) of firm power during peak demand hours on Wednesday at prices $1.00 per megawatt (MWh) higher than the previous day, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA offered next-day peak firm power at $13.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and at $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Offers of unlimited firm power during light load hours on Wednesday remained unchanged at $9.00 a MWh.
BPA reduced Wednesday prices for non-firm power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT to $7.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $8.00 for COB, compared with a flat price of $9.00 for Tuesday.
Prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0600-0700 and 2300 PDT were unchanged at $10.00 for all deliveries.
